in_marathi.name: Tapu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tapu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tapas', meaning 'heat, heat produced by friction'. In Hinduism, Tapu refers to the divine being that represents the deity of fire. It is also a term used to refer to a purification ritual, where the individual is cleansed of impurities to become 'pure' or 'Tapu'. The name Tapu is associated with the qualities of light, gentleness, and happiness.
